deduped.fix: Reuse translated New terminal and Alerts labels on the actual buttons. Verify names before any alert and with alerts present, and retain keyboard focus.

deduped.fix: Remove excessive opacity from inherited sidebar text and use readable existing foreground tokens on the status surface. Remeasure actual light/dark backgrounds; keep user theme choices and the existing design system.

deduped.check: BC-9 / CRAP Contrast: 12px destructive text measures 4.42:1 on the actual light tinted background; dark is 6.57:1. This is text carrying the reason sending is disabled, not decoration.
deduped.fix: Use an existing scoped readable destructive foreground treatment for this banner and verify at least 4.5:1 in both themes; preserve the neutral surfaces, Inter and paired Hafidh accent.

deduped.surface: Pi blocked composer to Agent Settings
deduped.check: assertions BC-3 and BC-7 | first-point-of-failure: wrong-state-rendered (recovery guidance). At 390px the 1310px full setup string occupies a 332px one-line clipped button. Shift+Tab then Enter correctly opens /settings/agents?agent=pi, where the configuration offers a claude-sonnet-5 placeholder and Thinking Off, with no visible Desk-specific Astra/max or adapter-catalogue readiness guidance.
deduped.fix: Expose the complete setup reason without hover and label the action Open Pi settings. Show the required Astra/max catalogue setup and separate adapter availability from Desk readiness at the destination; preserve the fail-closed model guard and existing credentials. Do not initiate login, install or inference automatically.
